title: Data Science with Python
prereqs: pip install numpy pandas scikit-learn matplotlib
description: End-to-end data science in Python: NumPy vectorization, pandas for wrangling & cleaning, exploratory analysis & visualization (matplotlib/seaborn), probability & statistics (distributions, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals), feature engineering, the scikit-learn workflow (regression, classification, clustering), model evaluation & cross-validation, pipelines & data-leakage avoidance, and a capstone — each step a runnable, pytest-checked exercise on real datasets.
